title: Draft
description: JSON Schema for Draft data structures

$schema.description: path to the JSON Schema to use for the validation of the JSON file describing the draft

filmId.description: unique identifier of the film whose review this draft belongs to

reviewerId.description: unique identifier of the reviewer whose review this draft belongs to

version.description: sequential version number of the draft, where version 0 is the initial empty draft

text.description: the textual content of the draft

userRole.description: the role of the user who authored this draft
